High-quality painted 2D game sprite, sharp coherent dark contours and restrained soft shading, readable when scaled to 160 pixels, not flat vector. Genuinely transparent background, opaque subject, NO ground shadow, no text, no UI, no other characters, generous margins. One complete figure only.
